Not validated engineering or safety instructions. Mountain-400-W. Fictional assembly demonstration for Mountain-400-W model 22, using Mountain-400-W Silver, 38, product 980 (BK-M38S-38), as the representative product.<Location LocationID="50" SetupHours="0.1" LaborHours="0.4" MachineHours="0.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 50 - Subassembly. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Subassembly: receive and visually check the completed frame and wheel subassemblies before final assembly.<step>Check 1 EA <material>ML Mountain Frame-W - Silver, 38 (Product Number FR-M63S-38)</material> for visible damage and confirm its size and color.</step><step>Check 1 EA <material>LL Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M423)</material> and 1 EA <material>LL Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M423)</material> for visible damage and free rotation using an assumed <tool>wheel stand</tool>.</step></Location><Location LocationID="60" SetupHours="0.2" LaborHours="2.0" MachineHours="0.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 60 - Final Assembly. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Final Assembly: fit the representative components and perform simple demonstration checks.<step>Support 1 EA <material>ML Mountain Frame-W - Silver, 38 (Product Number FR-M63S-38)</material> in an assumed <tool>bicycle assembly stand</tool>. Fit 1 EA <material>ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451)</material> at the frame and fork steering interface, then fit 1 EA <material>LL Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M243)</material> and check that steering moves freely.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>LL Mountain Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-M198)</material> to the frame and check that it is held securely.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>LL Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M423)</material> at the fork and 1 EA <material>LL Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M423)</material> at the rear of the frame. Check that both rotate freely; see <diag>100221</diag>.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>LL Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-7421)</material> to the frame, followed by 1 EA <material>ML Crankset (Product Number CS-6583)</material> and the BOM-listed 1 EA <material>LL Mountain Pedal (Product Number PD-M282)</material>.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>Front Derailleur (Product Number FD-2342)</material> and 1 EA <material>Rear Derailleur (Product Number RD-2308)</material>, then fit 1 EA <material>Chain (Product Number CH-0234)</material> through the drivetrain. Check movement by hand.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>Front Brakes (Product Number FB-9873)</material> at the front and 1 EA <material>Rear Brakes (Product Number RB-9231)</material> at the rear. Check their operation and wheel clearance.</step><step>Visually check the assembled bicycle for loose or damaged components and confirm that the wheels and steering move freely. Record any issue for review; these checks do not certify the bicycle for use.</step></Location></root>
processNotes: Historical routing records final assembly at work center 60 for product 980; the preceding subassembly work at center 50 and the operations shown are inferred.
Manufactured components are supplied as completed subassemblies for this demonstration. Purchased components are fitted and inspected, not manufactured here.

Each direct component is listed as 1 EA in the representative BOM, including the pedal. The record does not establish whether that pedal entry represents one pedal or a set; do not assume an additional quantity.
variantNotes: All four listed variants are silver: product 980 is size 38, 981 is size 40, 982 is size 42, and 983 is size 46.

The size 38 recipe uses frame 942 (FR-M63S-38). Size 40 uses frame 904 (FR-M63S-40), size 42 uses frame 905 (FR-M63S-42), and size 46 uses frame 906 (FR-M63S-46); do not substitute the size 38 frame for another size.
The listed direct BOMs use the same other components and quantities across these variants, including front wheel 815 and rear wheel 823. No wheel or color substitution is indicated.
The semi-gloss finish description is specifically for the size 46 variant; the snapshot does not establish that finish for the other sizes.

100221.title: Frame and wheel placement
guidance: Support 1 EA ML Mountain Frame-W - Silver, 38 (Product Number FR-M63S-38) in an assumed bicycle assembly stand. Fit 1 EA ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451) at the frame and fork steering interface, then fit 1 EA LL Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M243) and check that steering moves freely.
Fit 1 EA LL Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M423) at the fork and 1 EA LL Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M423) at the rear of the frame. Check that both rotate freely; see 100221.
